name: estatesales_search
description: Upcoming estate sales, moving sales and estate auctions near a US ZIP code, from EstateSales.NET — the largest US estate-sale listing site. Returns each sale's ID, city/state/ZIP, coordinates, distance from the ZIP, sale type (on-site estate sale, moved offsite, online auction), start and end dates, and whether it runs today or tomorrow. These are UPCOMING sale listings, not sold prices — EstateSales.NET publishes no hammer prices.

postal_code.description: US ZIP code, e.g. "64111". The site resolves it to its city page.

state_code.description: Optional 2-letter state code, e.g. "MO". Only needed to disambiguate; the ZIP alone normally resolves.

city.description: Optional city name, e.g. "Kansas City". Normally unnecessary — the ZIP resolves it.

name: estatesales_sale
description: One EstateSales.NET sale in full, by sale ID: name, description, terms, sale type, every scheduled date/time, coordinates, picture count, and the company or seller running it with their phone and page. The street address is included only once EstateSales.NET has published it — estate sales are usually at a private home and the site holds the address back until shortly before the sale.

sale_id.description: EstateSales.NET sale ID, e.g. 5065767 (the `id` from estatesales_search)

name: estatesales_companies
description: Estate-sale companies operating near a US ZIP code, as listed on EstateSales.NET: company name, business address, phone, coordinates and their EstateSales.NET page. Answers "who runs estate sales in this area" — for hiring one, or for tracing which company is behind a sale found via estatesales_search.
